description: The agent must: (1) Read the collaboration transcript and identify TWO genuinely stable, separable capabilities — 'difficulty calibration' and 'learner weakness diagnosis' — from the session log, while ignoring the abandoned IRT exploration in the archive. (2) Apply the SKILL.md's 'Less is more / single capability per skill' principle and decide to split into TWO independent SKILL.md packages rather than bundling them. (3) Each SKILL.md must document all 5 required output items: what ability was extracted, why it's worth skilling, the split-or-merge decision rationale, skill boundaries, and a verification plan. (4) Key proprietary decision points must be captured with their REASONS (not just steps): N=5 rolling window chosen over N=3/N=7, P90 cap guard for high performers, normalized vs. raw scores, 40% error threshold over 30%, and the 5-attempt minimum before flagging weakness. (5) A memory/design rationale annotation must be included (the 记忆沉淀 step). (6) Each skill package must be placed in its own directory with references/ or templates/ subdirectories created as per the packaging step. A naive agent will fail by: bundling both capabilities into one file, writing steps-only documentation without decision rationale, missing the P90/N=5/normalization decisions, or omitting the memory annotation.
